why: A delivers everything the client named in a consistent warm Nordic palette of birch, cream and natural fibres, and its 185 cm dining table seats six comfortably. B's 140×78 cm table cannot seat six 56 cm-wide armchairs, and its dark-legged sofa and gold-legged sideboard stray from the light-wood Nordic brief; A's only weak spots are the darker walnut sideboard and the red-and-yellow print.
